term: order of being by approach to a primary (attribution order model)
definition: `ApproachToPrimaryReading InAct MoreIn r near p`: the primary p has r; x is more r than y exactly when x approaches p more nearly (near y < near x, degrees in their own Mathlib `Preorder`); and every x other than p approaches it less nearly than p stands (near x < near p). It says nothing about causation; the causal order of others to the primary is the separate STMT-OTHERS-ORDERED-TO-PRIMARY-AS-CAUSE.
